info.title: jeeves-meta
info.description: HTTP API of the jeeves-meta service: the routes in its endpoint catalog (META_CATALOG). The API has no authentication: restrict the bind address or firewall the port.

get.description: Get meta service health, version, and uptime.
List metas with summary stats and per-meta projection. Response includes phaseState and owedPhase per meta.
